title: Advanced loot
summary: Personal loot, saved rules, group rolls and Loot All.
body:
Custom loot window

Open /advloot to see personal and shared drops together. Inspect an item, find its corpse, or leave that drop behind without changing its saved rule. Drops stay organized across pages.

Loot All for earned drops

Collect eligible drops you have earned across the current zone or instance, with a result message. Formerly restricted items no longer require a NO TRADE confirmation under free trading. Bag space, cursor state and loot rights still matter; ordinary and public-corpse looting remain range-limited. LORE restrictions are disabled, so duplicates are allowed.

Ignore unwanted drops

Click Never Loot beside an item to save Never for your character. Click the checked choice again, or Remove it from Filters, to return to Ask. Turn on Use saved rules to apply your choices.

Saved loot preferences and filter search

Choose Ask, Always loot, or Never for an item, with saved Need and Greed choices for shared rolls. In Filters, type or paste up to 32 plain-text characters from the item name, then click Search or press Enter. Clear removes the search. Preferences stay with that character after reconnecting.

Need, Greed, and Pass

Shared loot supports timed rolls. Need takes priority over Greed, and only eligible players can win. You can pass on an item you do not want.

Group assignment and free grab

The eligible loot leader can assign a shared drop to an eligible player or open it for manual free grab. Existing loot rights still apply.

Automatic coin collection and optional splitting

Eligible earned coins can be collected through advanced loot. Auto Split shares them with connected group or raid members in the current zone; the looter keeps any remainder.

Choose how the loot window behaves

Use Open on new loot to show the window automatically, Loot everything to collect eligible personal drops, or Unfiltered items only to focus on undecided items. Settings also control saved rules, coin splitting, and whether advanced loot is enabled. Turn it off to use ordinary corpse looting. With Open on new loot enabled, closing Filters or Settings leaves new eligible drops able to open the main loot list. Reloading the skin preserves an open loot window.

Main loot controls and item icons

Always Loot and Never Loot are available on each main-page item row. Choosing one replaces the other; clicking the active choice returns to Ask. Drops and Filters show larger, 32-pixel stock item images when available. Select an item or its icon, then click Inspect item directly on the main window. A confirmed transition from a nonempty to empty queue closes the window; you can reopen an empty window to manage settings and filters. For this repair, fully exit EverQuest and use launcher Play to install client 2026110605.
